basis: HUS defines blood/renal injury; rhizomelic shortening defines skeletal disease. Developmental delay 2/2; immune abnormalities omitted at the four-axis cap.
Congenital ichthyosis with defining neonatal respiratory failure in 80-99%; eosinophilia alone does not establish blood-organ damage; asthma/allergies 6/23.
Neoplasm arising in major salivary glands, which belong to the gastrointestinal axis.
Developmental pulmonary hypoplasia with absent functional gas exchange and lethal neonatal respiratory insufficiency.
Benign neoplasm of vascular tissue; the umbrella does not establish a common additional organ site.
Ovarian germ cell malignancy; reproductive tumour origin has no axis. Immature neural tissue does not establish CNS disease.
Spastic ataxia and intellectual disability define neurologic disease; defining optic atrophy belongs to the ocular axis.
Congenital benign cystic tumour occupying the orbit; epithelial contents do not establish a separate skin disorder.
Bladder/cloacal exstrophy, anorectal and skeletal spinal malformations define OEIS; myelomeningocele occurs in 30-79%, supporting neurologic involvement.
Hereditary corticospinal and peripheral nerve disease; weakness and amyotrophy reflect denervation rather than a separate primary muscle lesion.
Congenital tibial non-union is skeletal disease; associated neurofibromatosis is a separate condition.
Neurodevelopmental/cerebellar disease; fixed contractures 2/3, ventricular septal defect 1/3 and optic disc hypoplasia 1/3 support involvement; small cohort.
Isolated sperm flagellar abnormalities causing male infertility; reproductive dysfunction has no axis.
Anorectal and sacral malformations define the triad; anterior sacral meningocele occurs in 30-79%. Renal abnormalities are occasional.
Benign serous epithelial neoplasm usually arising from the ovarian surface; reproductive site has no axis.
Immune-mediated inflammatory bowel disease affecting the colon; no common additional organ damage established.
Developmental and epileptic encephalopathy; structural pituitary hypoplasia reported in 4/5 imaged patients supports endocrine-gland involvement.
Gastric epithelial malignancy defined by EBV infection within tumour cells; stomach origin and viral mechanism apply.
BFSP1-related nonsyndromic cataract affects the lens; cortical cataract documented in 3/3 patients.
Carcinoma arising in the lung; lymphoplasmacytic infiltration does not itself establish lymphoma or an immune-mediated disease.
Inherited alkaline-phosphatase metabolic disorder defined by osteomalacia, fractures, arthropathy and dental abnormalities; teeth belong to gastrointestinal.
Myelodysplastic/myeloproliferative neoplasm of neutrophils and marrow with leukocytosis and multilineage dysplasia.
Necrotizing bacterial infection of skin and subcutaneous tissue; deeper fascial or muscle disease is not established by this concept.
Structural oesophageal disease characterized by multiple diverticula.
Isolated congenital absence of mammary glands; breast abnormalities have no axis.
